summary: Single Metrocount piezo (counter 167) on the Pellizzer Blvd shared path, Kellyville, 2021-10-18 to 2026-09-20, one record per slot, low volume (~12-26 bikes/day per direction) with balanced East/West and no doubling, duplicates or level shifts. The only automatic fix is 'warning', which here marks exactly every direction-day with a zero total; most of these fall on rainy days where the same unit counted 0-4 bikes in the other direction, so they are restored as real zeros, while isolated zero days between normal days (2022-07-10, 2022-07-16 West, 2022-09-03, 2025-10-20) stay missing. No series definition is needed.
